answer: Cost binds at the claim, not the door. To count in an epoch, an identity crosses the bridge onto the roll, paying a yarrow ticket to the burn pot: 5 POA per attempt, no rebate. Its rope is velvet: anyone crosses, everyone pays. Each epoch a yarrow draw challenges 1 in 10 keys for a fresh signature; rotating auditors replay all. A miss voids the ticket and benches the key one epoch; a shared bridge voids both keys. Fakes pay forever: N fakes × 5 POA = 5N POA burned each epoch. Limit: honesty pays the same toll.
